FunctionHotspot.description: Aggregated active-time metrics for a function and optional context.

avg_active_ns.description: Integer arithmetic mean active duration of one activation.

context_id.description: Context dictionary identifier when the report is context-partitioned.

inclusive_active_ns.description: Inclusive active time across all activations.

incomplete_count.description: Number of activations reconstructed from incomplete boundaries.

max_active_ns.description: Maximum active duration of one activation.

min_active_ns.description: Minimum active duration of one activation.

self_active_ns.description: Self active time across all activations.

Quality.description: Describes how directly a value is supported by the captured trace.

oneOf.description: The trace directly and completely determines the value.
The value is reconstructed from incomplete but deterministic evidence.
The value is an estimate obtained from statistical samples.

SamplingHotspot.description: Statistical hotspot data obtained from program-counter samples.

address.description: Raw sampled address when no function resolution is available.

context_id.description: Context identifier when the report is context-partitioned.

estimated_share.description: Estimated fraction of represented samples in the inclusive range 0 to 1.

sample_count.description: Number of samples attributed to this row.

description: A hotspot report containing deterministic and sampling-derived sections.

quality.description: Overall evidence quality of the report.

sampling.description: Statistical sampling aggregates, kept separate from span aggregates.

title: HotspotReport
